message.content: Anne J. Kepner is the researched candidate for Trustee Area 3 (West Valley-Mission Community College District). In her SD-10 questionnaire, she stated she would support combating antisemitism and study AB 715 with all sides to develop an implementation plan, without giving an unqualified pledge against amendments. On Gaza and broader foreign policy, she characterized such positions as outside state and local duties, while stating support for Israel's existence and opposition to denial of a people's self-determination. CAIR Action endorsed her for the general election. No other candidate in this race has a researched record.
